cats.zh: 省钱 · 账单 · 索赔

cases.t: 车险一键切换，年省 $3,500
cases.te: One-click car insurance switch, $3,500/yr saved
cases.d: 上传现有车险保单，要求“同等保障找更便宜的”；约 5 分钟内 Muse 找到新方案、完成购买并取消旧保单。
cases.de: Uploaded his policy, asked for cheaper identical coverage; in ~5 min Muse found a new plan, bought it and cancelled the old one.

cases.t: Xfinity 电话砍价，5 年省约 $5,118
cases.te: Xfinity phone haggle, ~$5,118 over 5 years
cases.d: 让 Muse 打电话给 Xfinity，闯过电话菜单树，身份验证环节再把本人接进来，全程有 agent 与客服对话实录。
cases.de: Had Muse call Xfinity, navigate the phone tree, patch him in live at verification — with a full agent–rep transcript.

cases.t: Verizon 账单 $516→$386/月，睡前发起醒来办好
cases.te: Verizon $516 → $386/mo, negotiated overnight
cases.d: 发起 Verizon 客服聊天后直接去睡觉，Muse 连夜把账单谈下来。
cases.de: Started a support chat, went to bed; Muse brought the bill down overnight.

cases.t: AT&T 宽带 $80→$30/月＋3 个月免费＋网速翻倍
cases.te: AT&T broadband $80 → $30/mo + 3 months free + doubled speed
cases.d: 账单谈判类授权话术可直接套用：“低于 X 元就接受”。
cases.de: Bill-negotiation authorization scripts you can copy directly.

cases.t: AT&T 光纤 $80→$40/月＋3 个月免费
cases.te: AT&T fiber $80 → $40/mo + 3 months free
cases.d: 授权 Muse“接受任何低于 $70/月的方案”，由它去谈判。注意部分电话谈判案例实际有人工客服参与。
cases.de: Authorized Muse to “accept anything under $70/mo”. Caveat: some viral “phone negotiation” cases reportedly involved human agents.

cases.t: 两户 AT&T 账单，24 个月合计省 $1,920
cases.te: Two households' AT&T bills, ~$1,920 over 24 months
cases.d: 让 Muse 替两户家庭的 AT&T 网络账单谈价。
cases.de: Had Muse negotiate AT&T internet bills for two households.

cases.t: 车险比价 15 分钟，年省 $1,156
cases.te: Car insurance shopped in 15 min, ~$1,156/yr saved
cases.d: 在健身房随手上传当前车险单，Muse 按同等保障比价。碎片时间交办的典范。
cases.de: Uploaded his policy at the gym; Muse shopped identical coverage.

cases.t: 医疗账单逐行审计，省下 $4,000+
cases.te: Medical bills audited line by line, $4,000+ saved
cases.d: 把 Muse 接进医疗服务商 portal，拉出明细账单逐行质疑，发现多处重复收费并申请折扣。
cases.de: Logged Muse into the medical provider portal, questioned every line, found double billings, requested discounts.

cases.te: Water heater $1,450 vs $2,300 quote ($850 saved)
cases.d: 午饭时把坏掉的热水器型号发给 Muse；它比了 3 家店的价格，给 2 个安装师傅发邮件询价，并约好周四上门安装。
cases.de: Texted the model number at lunch; Muse compared 3 shops, emailed 2 installers, booked Thursday install.

cases.t: 克罗地亚—意大利轮渡，省 $2,200 异地还车费
cases.te: Croatia–Italy car ferry, $2,200 drop-off fees saved
cases.d: Muse 找到并订好汽车轮渡，从租车合同里提取车牌/车型信息，并确认保险覆盖跨境。
cases.de: Muse found and booked the ferry, pulled plate/model from the rental agreement, confirmed insurance coverage.

cases.te: Car insurance $500 → $335/mo (~$1,980/yr)
cases.d: 去超市买东西的功夫，Muse 搜集了 4 家车险报价（Tesla 转 CSAA），当天就切换。
cases.de: Muse gathered 4 quotes while he grocery-shopped (Tesla → CSAA); switched the same day.

cases.t: United 航班降价追踪，拿回约 $1,026
cases.te: United price-drop tracking, ~$1,026 credit
cases.d: 持续追踪已订 United 航班的降价，然后找客服把差价要回来。“帮我盯着已订的航班，降了就去要差价”。
cases.de: Tracked a booked United flight, chatted with United to secure the credit.

cases.t: 为岳父找回 $1,750 无人认领财产
cases.te: $1,750 unclaimed property recovered for father-in-law
cases.d: 搜遍住过的所有州的无人认领财产登记，填表申领；另比价网络/电话套餐再省约 $120/月。
cases.de: Searched every lived-in state's unclaimed-property registry; plus ~$120/mo off bills via plan comparison.

cases.t: 跨州搜无人认领财产，10 分钟找回 $800+
cases.te: Unclaimed property sweep, $800+ in ~10 min
cases.d: 一句话交办：“查我住过的所有州有没有我的无人认领财产”。
cases.de: One prompt: check every state lived in.

cases.t: Amazon 退货 $239 ＋ 狗看病理赔 $516
cases.te: Amazon returns ($239) + dog vet claim ($516)
cases.d: 清理卡住的 Amazon 退货，顺手把狗看病的保险理赔也提交了。该作者同期还晒过 $2,120.95 的累计省钱清单。
cases.de: Cleared stalled Amazon returns and filed a dog vet claim. He also posted a $2,120.95 cumulative savings list.

cases.t: PODS 搬家比报价低 $576
cases.te: PODS move $576 under quote + missing tax K-1s found
cases.d: 给妈妈订 PODS 搬家服务谈到比报价低 $576；另建 2025 税务文档追踪表，找出缺失的 K-1 表。
cases.de: Booked mom's PODS move under quote; built a 2025 tax-doc tracker.

cases.t: 揪出 $100/月被遗忘的 Claude Max
cases.te: Email receipt audit found forgotten $100/mo Claude Max
cases.d: 扫描 6 个月邮件收据，发现公司卡上一个被遗忘的 $100/月 Claude Max 订阅。“审计我所有订阅，找出没在用的”。
cases.de: Scanned 6 months of receipts; found a forgotten $100/mo subscription on a company card.

cases.t: 车险分析，年省 $603
cases.te: Car insurance analysis, ~$603/yr saved
cases.d: 上传保单让 Muse 分析，找出更便宜的等效方案。
cases.de: Uploaded his policy; Muse found a cheaper equivalent.

cases.t: 航班延误邮件索赔，拿回 $200
cases.te: Flight-delay claim by email, $200 back
cases.d: 航班大延误后全程用邮件跟航司交涉拿回补偿。
cases.de: Handled a major flight delay with the airline over email.

cases.t: WiFi 账单 10 分钟砍下 $300
cases.te: WiFi bill haggled down $300 in under 10 min
cases.d: Muse 直接替他跟客服代表砍价。
cases.de: Muse haggled with the rep on his behalf.

cases.t: Alaska 航班取消索赔 $189.37
cases.te: Alaska cancellation claim $189.37
cases.d: 从邮件里翻出取消的航班和 Lyft 收据，搞定坏掉的上传组件后提交索赔，拿到 case number。
cases.de: Dug the cancelled flight + Lyft receipts out of email, fought a broken upload widget, filed with case number.

cases.t: 找回妻子遗忘一年多的图书订阅费
cases.te: Recovered a year of forgotten subscription fees
cases.d: Muse 扫描账单，发现妻子一年多前忘记取消的图书订阅，自动取消并按退款政策追回。零门槛，人人可用。
cases.de: Muse scanned bills, found a book subscription his wife forgot to cancel 1+ years ago, cancelled and recovered a full year.

cases.t: 订阅审计省 $200
cases.te: Subscription audit saved $200
cases.a: Nicolas Bustamante（@nicbstme，微软 AI 从业者）
cases.d: 让 Muse 检查循环订阅，取消不再需要的。同一帖还提到 24 小时内 Muse 帮他买了袜子、订了 groceries、约了保洁。
cases.de: Had Muse review recurring subscriptions and cancel the unneeded ones.

cases.t: 买车现场防坑，省 $1,250
cases.te: Dodged $1,250 in dealership upsells
cases.d: 在经销商买车/买断租约时让 Muse 审查费用明细，识别不必要的附加服务和高额手续费。出自 #MuseMoneyChallenge 期间的媒体报道。
cases.de: Had Muse review the fee breakdown when buying/buying out a lease. Reported during Meta's #MuseMoneyChallenge.

cases.t: 电话谈判，一年省 $800+
cases.te: Phone negotiation, $800+/yr saved
cases.d: Muse 代打客服电话谈有线电视和电话账单。
cases.de: Muse called to negotiate cable + phone bills.

cases.t: “Fred”取消订阅＋车险比价，年省 $2,500+
cases.te: Muse named “Fred”: subscriptions cancelled + insurance compared, $2,500+/yr
cases.d: 给 Muse 取名 Fred，先翻出长期不用的订阅逐一取消，再对比各家车险报价逐项汇报（2026-10-08 reel 实拍）。
cases.de: Named his Muse Fred; it cancelled unused subscriptions one by one, then compared insurance quotes (2026-10-08 reel).

cases.t: Verizon $100 礼品卡抵账单
cases.te: $100 Verizon gift card applied to bill
cases.d: Muse 确认礼品卡可抵账户余额后，直接在 Verizon 官网完成抵扣支付。
cases.de: Muse confirmed the gift card could offset the balance, then completed it on Verizon's site.

cases.t: 24 小时健康杂事：$80 Oura 折扣
cases.te: 24h health errands: $80 Oura discount + benefits done right
cases.d: 24 小时内约流感疫苗、找到 $80 Oura Ring 折扣、正确注册福利计划（没多交 HSA）。
cases.de: Flu shot scheduled, $80 Oura Ring discount found, benefits enrolled without HSA over-contribution — in 24 hours.

cases.t: 航班延误 7 小时，5 分钟拿到 $250 积分
cases.te: 7-hour delay → $250 Delta credit in 5 min
cases.d: 航班延误后直接让 Muse 处理索赔——自动填投诉表、找替代航班重新预订、回复客服邮件，全程约 5 分钟。
cases.de: Muse filed the complaint, rebooked an alternative flight, replied to support emails — about 5 minutes.

cases.t: 机票/酒店降价追踪＋自动通知
cases.te: Flight/hotel price-drop tracking with notifications
cases.d: 设定目标航班/酒店，让 Muse 持续监控降价并推送通知。Threads @adambader 用同类玩法省 $600。
cases.de: Set target flights/hotels; Muse monitors drops and pushes notifications. Threads @adambader saved $600 the same way.

cases.t: 隔夜航班自动值机
cases.te: Overnight flight auto check-in
cases.d: 半夜睡觉时 Muse 自动帮他办好航班值机。
cases.de: Muse checked him into his flight overnight while he slept.

cases.t: REAL ID 预约
cases.te: REAL ID appointment booking
cases.d: 约号、抢号类政务/服务预约可类比。
cases.de: Government/service appointment sniping, by analogy.

cases.t: 护照续签＋泰国酒店预订一条龙
cases.te: Passport renewal + Thailand hotel booking, end to end
cases.d: 护照续签无缝交接浏览器；随后在 Amex Travel 订好往返机票（含选座、TSA 号）。
cases.de: Passport renewal handed off in-browser; then couple flights booked on Amex Travel.

cases.t: 让 Muse 替你在 Southwest 电话里排队
cases.te: Had Muse wait on hold with Southwest
cases.d: 用 Muse 的通话功能打给 Southwest 排队，接通真人客服后再回拨他手机。“替我打电话排队，接通了再叫我”。
cases.de: Muse called, waited on hold, called him back when a rep was live.

cases.t: United 行李索赔全程代办
cases.te: United baggage claim handled end to end
cases.d: United 行李延误/丢失索赔全程代办，只提供了购买收据和行李单号，零文书时间。
cases.de: Delayed/lost baggage claim fully handled; only receipts + baggage ref provided. Zero paperwork.

cases.t: 误机后躺床上跨航司比价改签
cases.te: Missed flight → rebooked from bed across airlines
cases.d: 错过航班后让 Muse 对比其他航司备选、提醒 Flex 票可免费改、给出客服电话。
cases.de: Compared alternatives across airlines, flagged the free Flex-ticket change, gave the support number.

cases.t: $3,000 旅行预订全托管
cases.te: $3,000 trip booking fully managed
cases.d: 整单旅行预订和酒店全交给 Muse。作者一个月前还坚决不让 AI 碰真实交易，因支付安全设计改主意。
cases.de: Entire trip booking + hotels handed to Muse. He'd sworn off letting AI touch real transactions a month earlier.

cases.t: 撒丁岛之旅，邮件谈直订省 €240
cases.te: Sardinia trip: emailed hotel for direct booking, saved €240
cases.ae: Chelsea Yamase (@chelseakauai, IG travel creator, 1.2M followers)
cases.d: 翻几百条收藏、生成路线图、推荐精品酒店、查实时房态；发邮件跟酒店谈到直接预订。
cases.de: Browsed hundreds of saves, built the route, picked boutique hotels, checked availability; emailed the hotel into a direct booking.

cases.t: 拍照一键上架 Marketplace
cases.te: Photo → Marketplace listing (pricing + copy in one shot)
cases.d: 闲鱼/Marketplace 卖家可直接套用：“拍照→定价→写文案→上架”。
cases.de: The playbook secondhand sellers can copy: photo → price → copy → list.

cases.t: Marketplace 砍价谈判
cases.te: Marketplace price negotiation
cases.d: 找到 Marketplace 商品、谈价、约自提一条龙。
cases.de: Found the item, negotiated the price, arranged pickup — end to end.

cases.t: 白板照片 → Sam's Club 杂货一键下单
cases.te: Whiteboard photo → Sam's Club grocery order
cases.d: 拍一张冰箱白板购物清单照片，Muse 识别后直接下单买齐。适合家庭采购。
cases.de: Photographed a messy fridge whiteboard list; Muse ordered everything. Great for family shopping.

cases.t: 屠榜 50 个卖家，$2,500 拿下全新 M5 Pro MacBook
cases.te: Lowballed ~50 sellers, $2,500 for a brand-new M5 Pro MacBook
cases.d: 让 Muse 去跟约 50 个 Facebook Marketplace 卖家逐一砍价，最终拿下全新 M5 Pro（48GB/2TB）。
cases.de: Had Muse haggle ~50 Facebook Marketplace sellers one by one; landed a brand-new M5 Pro (48GB/2TB).

cases.t: 1 分钟起草 5 个 listing
cases.te: 5 listings drafted in 1 minute
cases.d: 发一张商品照片，1 分钟内搞定定价＋5 个待发布 listing；买家模式找二手公路车几秒返回多辆车源。二手卖家效率神器。
cases.de: One product photo → pricing + 5 listings in a minute; buyer-mode demo found used road bikes in seconds.

cases.t: Amazon / IKEA 退货代办
cases.te: Amazon / IKEA returns handled
cases.d: 联系客服、预约上门取件全程跑完。
cases.de: Customer service + pickup scheduling, all handled.

cases.t: eBay 捡漏改自动推送
cases.te: eBay deal-hunting turned into auto-digests
cases.d: 以前每晚花 30 分钟手动翻 eBay，现在每天两次收到过滤好的捡漏清单（只收成色极佳/BNIB、带 Buy It Now）。收藏党的“条件单”。
cases.de: From 30 min/night manual browsing to twice-daily filtered deal lists. A collector's standing order.

cases.t: 跑鞋全网比价＋降价哨兵
cases.te: Running-shoe price comparison + drop sentinel
cases.d: New Balance 跑鞋全网最低价横向比价，之后每天自动检查降价。“比价一次、盯价长期”。
cases.de: Lowest price across the web for running shoes, then daily drop checks.

cases.t: 邮箱大扫除：退订 / 重订 / 每日简报
cases.te: Inbox zero: unsubscribes / resubscribes / daily digest
cases.d: “清理我的邮箱”是最值得第一次尝试的指令之一。
cases.de: “Clean up my inbox” is one of the best first prompts to try.

cases.t: 语音备忘录“记下来”自动存档
cases.te: Voice memo “note this down” auto-archived
cases.d: 随手语音“记下来”，Muse 自动整理进笔记本。
cases.de: Say “note this down”; Muse files it into the notebook.

cases.t: 一句话生成看板
cases.te: One-sentence Kanban board generation
cases.d: 一句话描述需求，生成可用的看板。
cases.de: Describe the need in one sentence; get a working board.

cases.t: 目标设定＋Agent 督战
cases.te: Goal setting with agent accountability
cases.d: 把目标交给 AI 追踪进度、定期汇报。
cases.de: Hand goals to the AI; it tracks progress and reports back.

cases.t: 90 个数据经纪商 opt-out
cases.te: 90 data-broker opt-outs
cases.d: 让 Muse 逐个走完几十家数据经纪商各自的删除流程，不用买删除服务。重复性跨站表单任务是 AI 的舒适区。
cases.de: Had Muse work through dozens of data brokers' individual removal flows. No removal service needed.

cases.t: DIY 版 Incogni，替掉付费订阅
cases.te: DIY Incogni, replaced a paid subscription
cases.d: 让 Muse 给能找到的每家数据经纪商发邮件要求删除，只用掉约 2% 的免费周额度。
cases.de: Emailed every data broker found; used ~2% of the free weekly quota.

cases.t: 7 天 10 任务压力测试
cases.te: 7-day, 10-task stress test
cases.r: 5 成功 / 2 出错 / 2 卡住 / 1 放弃
cases.d: 难得一见的“失败案例”实测，对合理预期很有价值。
cases.de: A rare honest failure report — valuable for setting expectations.

cases.t: 税务文件整理，一句话搞定约 90%
cases.te: Tax docs gathered, ~90% in one prompt
cases.d: 一句话让 Muse 对照去年税表、从邮件和 portal 里 pull 缺失文档，存进 Google Drive 交给会计师。
cases.de: One prompt: compare against last year's return, pull missing docs from email/portals into Drive for the accountant.

cases.t: “Bingbong”月度成绩单
cases.te: “Bingbong” monthly report
cases.d: 整理 80GB Google 相册、退订约 70 封 Gmail 推广、取消 3 个付费订阅、安排工作旅行。“不是做不到的事，而是我一直拖着没做的脏活”。
cases.de: 80GB Google Photos organized, ~70 Gmail promos unsubscribed, 3 paid subs cancelled. “Not things I couldn't do — things I kept putting off.”

cases.t: 100 万个 Google Drive 文件，5 分钟审计完
cases.te: 1M Google Drive files audited in 5 minutes
cases.d: Plaid 只读连银行做财务更新；AI 综合短信/邮件/日历/Drive 上下文做早晚报。作者称这套活请人做一年要 $40 万+。
cases.de: Plaid read-only banking for finance updates; AI briefings from SMS/email/calendar/Drive. He claims hiring humans would cost $400k+/yr.

cases.t: Amtrak 投诉拿回 $100
cases.te: Amtrak complaint, $100 credit back
cases.d: 坐 Amtrak 被冻到，“懒得自己撕”丢给 Muse：代写投诉信、没回复主动跟进。“20 秒的 prompt 换来的”。
cases.de: Frozen on Amtrak; handed the complaint to Muse: drafted the letter, followed up. “A 20-second prompt.”

cases.t: $1,800/月的行政外包，被 Muse 接管
cases.te: $1,800/mo of outsourced admin taken over by Muse
cases.d: 同时经营社交俱乐部、珠宝品牌并帮丈夫打理旅行生意；此前邮件/排期/跟进/行政全外包，现在 Muse 全接。
cases.de: Runs a social club, a jewelry brand, and her husband's travel business admin; previously all outsourced — now Muse does it.

cases.t: 每天早上 8 点的 AI 新闻播客
cases.te: Daily 8am AI-news podcast
cases.d: 个人简报流的标杆用法：“每天早上 8 点给我生成一份 AI 新闻播客”。
cases.de: The benchmark personal-briefing flow: “make me an AI news podcast every morning at 8”.

cases.t: 一晚建成 17muse.com＋FB 社团
cases.te: Built 17muse.com + FB community in one night
cases.re: Idea to live in one night
cases.d: 从想法到上线一晚搞定，独立开发者的效率样本。
cases.de: An indie developer's efficiency showcase.

cases.t: AI 课程市场调研 → 竞品分析网页
cases.te: AI-course market research → competitor-analysis page
cases.d: “调研 X 市场并生成一份竞品分析网页”，创业者/产品经理可直接套用。
cases.de: “Research the X market and generate a competitor-analysis page” — founders/PMs can copy this.

cases.t: 量身定制日语学习 Mini App
cases.te: Personalized Japanese-learning mini app
cases.d: 按自己水平定制的日语学习小应用。
cases.de: A mini app tailored to his own level.

cases.t: 按“氛围”找酒吧
cases.te: Finding a bar by “vibe”
cases.d: 描述想要的氛围，让 Muse 刷 Instagram Reels 找匹配的纽约鸡尾酒吧，附实拍视频供判断，并查订位情况。
cases.de: Described the vibe; Muse browsed Instagram Reels for matching NYC cocktail bars, with video previews + availability.

cases.t: 搬家打包计划表
cases.te: Moving-day packing schedule
cases.d: 告诉 Muse 还剩什么没打包、时间、想要短时突击，生成逐日计划＋首晚必需品清单。同期实测也暴露短板：推荐过已倒闭的餐厅。
cases.de: Told Muse what was left, the time available, and a preference for short bursts; got a daily plan + first-night essentials. Her test also exposed limits: it recommended long-closed restaurants.

cases.t: 2,572 条社媒帖建成“个人档案馆”

cases.r: 收藏夹的"考古"价值被低估了——agent 能把它变成比价单和内容诊断报告
cases.re: The 'archaeology' value of saved posts is underestimated — an agent turns them into comparison sheets and content audits
cases.d: "3 件你不知道 Muse 能干的事"——① 把 Muse 接进 Messenger 当砍价员，在 Marketplace 跟卖家谈一根 Tour AD MT-6 高尔夫杆身，$130 成交约面交；② 从收藏的 reel 里认出一台 3D 打印机型号（CA$999），直接做参数对比；③ 翻收藏帖追踪商品，并给 IG 账号做审计（2026-10-12 reel，录屏实测）
cases.de: '3 things you didn't know Muse could do': (1) plugged Muse into Messenger as a haggler, negotiated a Tour AD MT-6 golf shaft on Marketplace down to a $130 in-person deal; (2) identified a 3D printer model (CA$999) from saved reels and ran a spec comparison; (3) mined saved posts to track products and audited an IG account (2026-10-12 reel, screen-recorded)

cases.t: 助手"Nova"：上传整柜衣服照片 + 查日历，给晚宴搭出一身行头
cases.te: Assistant 'Nova': photographed his whole wardrobe + checked his calendar to style a dinner outfit
cases.r: 穿搭建议第一次有了前提——"看得到你的衣柜，也看得到你的行程"
cases.re: Styling advice with a premise for the first time — 'it sees your closet and your calendar'
cases.d: 先把衣柜的衣服拍照全喂给 Muse，助手取名"Nova"；要去吃晚饭时问 Nova 穿什么——Nova 按他实际有的衣服推荐黑亨利衫 + 深色阔腿裤；又查了他的日历、发现订位在户外，补了一件黑色长袖；鞋子在乐福鞋和球鞋之间选了更正式的乐福鞋，最后配了银表和手链（2026-10-12 发帖）
cases.de: He fed Muse photos of everything in his closet and named the assistant 'Nova'; when asked what to wear to dinner, Nova picked a black henley + dark wide-leg trousers from what he actually owns, checked his calendar, saw the reservation was outdoors and added a black long sleeve, chose loafers over sneakers, and finished with a silver watch and bracelet (2026-10-12 post)
